# Working on this assignment

This is your personal repo for this assignment — you're the only one working in it, so there's no pull request workflow here. A few notes on how your commit history factors into grading:

- **Commit as you go.** A minimum of 4 meaningful commits is expected. Don't write the whole solution locally and push it as one commit at the end — commit after each method or logical chunk (e.g. after `chooseWord()` works, after `getHint()` works, after tests pass). Code that "magically appears from the aether" in a single commit doesn't show your process.
- **Write commit messages that describe what changed**, not just `wip` or `fix`.
- **Push regularly.** The CI badge in the README reflects the state of whatever you last pushed — use it to check your progress as you go, not just at the end.
